protocol.description: LLM agent starts the no-response protocol conversation with the patient (watcher POSTs a [SYSTEM EVENT] to /chat/:patient; Ella warns again and asks what is going on).
Agent raises a critical alert on the patient's dashboard via the send_alert tool during the protocol conversation.
